Q: Javascript Calculator A:

Great beginner project! You correctly used addEventListener, but the main issue was that getElementsByClassName() returns an HTMLCollection, so you must access the element using input[0]. Once fixed, the calculator works as expected. Small projects like this are excellent for understanding DOM manipulation and calculation logic.

You can also explore real-world calculation tools like an online age calculator at https://hisab-ul-umar.com/ to see how input handling and date calculations work in practice.

Q: What difference do file extensions make for MIPS assembly files? A:

There is no innate difference between .s and .asm

If you want you can name the text file with .s and the hex file .asm but this would only be so that you could keep them straight.
